rationale: B has the bolder art direction: a huge metallic 'Halo' wordmark with the speaker rising in front of it, an exploded wireframe view, and a dark-to-cream rhythm with textured arch material swatches and a giant footer wordmark. A is refined and coherent but stays one warm-dark register throughout, with a pinned scrollytelling teardown and a room-placement plan. B's entrance flashes the whole finished hero at ~80 ms, blanks it, then rebuilds it, while A's masked headline and ring-light reveal is cleaner. B's hover states are more expressive (amber fill, glow) but its custom cursor ring covers the labels, whereas A's underline-and-glow feedback is quieter but always legible.
